## Eigene Beispiele / Code

::: panel-tabset
## R

```r
library(forecast)
fit <- auto.arima(ts_data)
forecast(fit, h = 12)
```

## Python

```python
from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA
model = ARIMA(ts_data, order=(1,1,1)).fit()
print(model.forecast(steps=12))
```
:::
